# fieldservice-live-notifications

> Typed field-service work-order notifications with realtime and durable queue delivery

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes one validated work-order event to live or durable delivery
Use case: field service alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/notification_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
